about.heading: Silicon Valley's Luxury Home Contractor
about.body: At Prime Design & Build, we stand proud as one of Silicon Valley's premium remodeling and construction authorities, specializing in a wide range of high-quality services tailored to meet your specific needs. Our well-established reputation is built on a foundation of quality craftsmanship and unparalleled customer service. Our dedicated team ensures a custom-tailored interaction with every client, guaranteeing that our high standards are consistently met with each project we undertake.

coreValues.description: The way we work matters as much as the spaces we create. These principles shape every conversation, decision, and detail from the first sketch to the final handoff.

guidingPrinciple.heading: Reliability in every project we take on.
paragraphs: We work closely with our clients to turn a clear vision into a home that feels considered, functional, and genuinely theirs.
From design and architecture through construction and completion, our team brings dependable communication, careful coordination, and a commitment to delivering on time and within budget.

faq.heading: A clearer way to begin.
faq.description: Here are a few of the questions homeowners ask before starting a remodeling or construction project with Prime Design & Build.

items.question: What sets Prime Design & Build apart from other remodeling companies?
items.answer: We combine design, construction, and project coordination in one experienced team. This keeps communication direct and helps us make decisions with the complete project in view.

items.question: What types of projects do you take on?
items.answer: We work on kitchens, bathrooms, complete home renovations, additions, ADUs, garage conversions, and new construction across Silicon Valley.

items.question: How do we get started?
items.answer: Start with a conversation about your goals, home, and timing. We will learn what you are trying to achieve and explain the next steps for developing your project.

items.question: Will I have a dedicated point of contact?
items.answer: Yes. Our project leadership and coordination team keeps communication organized and makes sure you know what is happening throughout the process.

items.question: Do you serve my area?
items.answer: We serve homeowners across Silicon Valley, including Campbell, San Jose, Palo Alto, Cupertino, Mountain View, Sunnyvale, and surrounding communities.
